$comment: Security invariants. Each maps to tests and, where the claim is physical, to executed evidence. Machine-readable so tools/verify_all.py can assert every invariant is still covered. Adding an invariant without tests is a merge blocker.

invariants.statement: An empty experiment cannot be reported as CLEAN.
invariants.rationale: A run that observed nothing because it never ran is not a negative result. KF-22.

invariants.statement: The core cannot execute privileged actions.
invariants.rationale: The load-bearing safety property of the whole system.

invariants.statement: The broker never trusts an authorization claim made by the core.
invariants.rationale: There is no field in ActionRequest in which permission can be asserted; caller identity comes from the kernel.

invariants.statement: Firewall state Annulon cannot prove it created is never deleted.
invariants.rationale: A security tool that removes the operator's firewall during an incident is the incident.

invariants.statement: An expired temporary action cannot become permanent.
invariants.rationale: Expiry runs in the privileged broker, so killing the core cannot extend a restriction.

invariants.statement: Missing evidence is never converted into negative evidence.
invariants.rationale: An unanswered probe is absence, not proof that nothing happened.

invariants.statement: A sensor that has not been self-probed cannot claim to be healthy.
invariants.rationale: A dead sensor reporting no events looks identical to a quiet host.

invariants.statement: Several detectors reading one observation are not independent corroboration.
invariants.rationale: Lineage, not count, determines whether evidence corroborates.

invariants.statement: A privileged action is durably recorded before the OS is touched.
invariants.rationale: A crash between apply and journal leaves state nobody will remove.

invariants.statement: No value from a request can alter the structure of a privileged command.
invariants.rationale: nft is driven through JSON built from typed values; no text is ever concatenated into a parser.
invariants.evidence: hostile comment stored verbatim as data, KF-37

invariants.statement: Containment is claimed only when control-plane and data-plane evidence agree.
invariants.rationale: A rule existing is not traffic stopping. Disagreement is ACTION_EFFECT_NOT_VERIFIED.

invariants.statement: A broken verifier yields EVIDENCE_INCOMPLETE, never CONTAINED.
invariants.rationale: The verifier is security-critical; its failure must not read as success. KF-22 family.
